messages:
sre-bot: ALERT: High 95th latency for /v1/generate in us-west-2 (5m avg) - threshold exceeded (2400ms) :warning:

sre-bot: Incident ID INC-2026-042 (automated) created. Paging on-call. Trigger rules: latency_slo_breach, repeated_5xx.

Janet (on-call): I'm live. Investigating now. tagging infra and runtime. 

alex: saw a spike in queue depth on the routing layer ~10:21 PDT, looks like two routes getting duplicate copy. can you confirm?

Janet (on-call): checking routing logs... pulling last 30m.

Janet (on-call): ok confirmed: there are duplicate upstream sends to dedicated-pool-A and fallback-dedicated-B for a subset of requests. looks like policy evaluate returned both true for some sessions.

Priya: that's the new weighted-fallback policy we rolled last week, right? we added a permissive compat rule.

Janet (on-call): yes. hypothesis: a recent policy change allowed overlapping match on model_version and region, causing requests to be enqueued twice when a fast path and a fallback path both matched.

ben: that would double-kill the scheduler and push queueing latency. can we hotfix by toggling the fallback to strict-exclude?

Janet (on-call): proposing immediate mitigation: set fallback.policy.match_mode = "exclude-overlap" and rate-limit fallback to 10% of baseline. applying now.

sre-bot: RUNBOOK ACTION: apply temporary config change - apply flag fallback-exclude=true.

Janet (on-call): applied fallback-exclude=true to us-west-2 routing tier. throttled fallback to 10%. watching.

alex: seeing queue depth falling on primary shards, 95th latency dropping to ~800ms. nice.

Maria (support): we have two customers reporting timeouts on embedded requests ~10:25 PDT. CS flagged high severity. I've opened tickets.

Janet (on-call): note: partial customer impact for 4% of requests in the window 10:18-10:30 PDT. affected: webhooks and some batched embedding jobs.

Sam (ops): are there any error 5xx spikes or mostly latency? need to message customers.

Janet (on-call): mostly increased timeouts and 503 on the fallback path when the backlog peaked. primary path responded eventually for most. No model regressions.

Priya: adding timeline: 10:16 change deployed to routing policy canary, 10:18 policy rolled to 30% for region, 10:20 automated rollout hit 100% due to rollout script bug. duplication starts at 10:20. mitigation at 10:23 toggled exclude, 10:26 throttled fallback.

ben: good catch on rollout script. that needs a stopgap guard.

Janet (on-call): reassigning to post-incident: Priya owner for policy fix, ben owner for rollout guard, Alex to verify metrics and add alert thresholds.

sre-bot: NOTE: create postmortem doc and schedule postmortem meeting. Use template /docs/postmortems/template.

Janet (on-call): Maria, can you coordinate customer comms? recommend sending a short note: apology, timeline, affected endpoints, and mitigation steps. ETA for initial comms 60m?

Maria (support): yes. I have draft. Will send initial comms in 45m and follow-up after root cause confirmed.

alex: quick log snippet for RCA: 
```
2026-03-15T10:20:12Z routing.evaluate request_id=abc123 matched=[primary-route, fallback-route] policy_version=20260315-8
2026-03-15T10:20:12Z scheduler.enqueue duplicate=true request_id=abc123
```
Janet (on-call): saving that to incident doc.

Priya: immediate remediation plan: revert permissive compat rule, add unit test to policy compiler to detect overlapping matches, add a rollout safety check to abort on immediate double-route matches > 0.5% in 5m.

ben: rollout guard plan: add post-deploy monitoring that watches for duplicate enqueue events and halts rollout via CI gate. I'll prototype a webhook for the deploy pipeline.

Sam (ops): operations tasks: scrub queues, ensure all duplicate-inflight requests drain gracefully, and increase autoscaler buffer for 1h to avoid cascade during rollback. I'll take that.

Janet (on-call): handoff: I'm wrapping up incident command. Moving to post-incident. logging final state: mitigation in prod, latency returning to normal, no further alerts for 10m.

sre-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: status -> mitigated. duration 00:24: affected customers notified (initial).

Janet (on-call): schedule postmortem meeting. prefer tomorrow 15:00 PDT. Priya, Ben, Alex, Sam, Maria please confirm availability.

Priya: available.

ben: available.

alex: can do.

Sam (ops): can do.

Maria (support): yes.

Janet (on-call): creating postmortem doc at /incidents/INC-2026-042/postmortem.md and a follow-up tasks spreadsheet. Assigning owners now: 
- Priya: root cause analysis & policy compiler tests (due 2026-03-22)
- ben: deploy pipeline guard + webhook (due 2026-03-19)
- alex: duplicate-enqueue alert and dashboards (due 2026-03-18)
- Sam (ops): queue scrub playbook + autoscaler buffer recipe (due 2026-03-17)
- Maria: customer follow-ups and comms log (due 2026-03-16)

Janet (on-call): action item: update runbook section Routing -> Fallback policies with explicit "match_mode" docs and a snippet for safe rollout. I'll draft and request review.

Priya: I'll review runbook edits. prefer we add an example config and a checklist for canary steps including automated duplicate-detection.

ben: also propose adding a canary rollback delay check so a rollout doesn't auto-promote from canary to full unless duplicate_enqueues==0 for 15m.

Janet (on-call): scheduling: created calendar invite 'INC-2026-042 postmortem' for 2026-03-16 15:00 PDT. Link in doc.

sre-bot: ACTIONS CREATED: 5 tasks linked to INC-2026-042. Reminder: owners should update status before postmortem.

Maria (support): initial comms sent to affected customers at 11:05 PDT. kept friendly and actionable.

Priya: note for long-term: evaluate policy DSL change to provide exclusive-match semantics by default, and telemetry to surface overlapping rules during authoring.

Sam (ops): I ran manual queue scrub, found ~12 duplicate-inflight tokens, drained them without additional errors. logged commands used in incident doc.

alex: dashboards updated with a new metric 'routing.duplicate_enqueues' and an alert at 0.5% of traffic sustained for 5m.

Janet (on-call): final checklist for closure: publish postmortem, mark actions in tracker, verify runbook edits merged, ensure customer follow-ups completed. I'll check off later today.

ben: thanks for the quick mitigation. good cross-team coordination.

Maria (support): closing customer tickets after follow-up confirmations.

sre-bot: INCIDENT CLOSED: status -> closed after postmortem scheduled and actions created.

Janet (on-call): closing thread. please update owners if dates slip. :white_check_mark:
